channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
item.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its Sept. 15-16 policy meeting.

item.title: Levi Strauss hikes profit guidance after tariff refunds, but its sales outlook is less optimistic
item.description: Levi Strauss on Wednesday posted earnings that beat expectations, though it saw benefits from tariff refunds.

item.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
item.description: The new device shows Microsoft remains committed to making its own PCs even though it's not one of the top device makers.

item.title: Supertanker chartered from Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, 10 times higher than pre-war level
item.description: Shipping costs have exploded as the war in the Persian Gulf has led to a shortage of available tankers.

item.title: FCC to vote on auctioning 25MHz of 'prime spectrum' in move that could benefit Amazon, SpaceX
item.description: SpaceX and Amazon have moved to expand providing direct-to-device services with networks of satellites.

item.title: Brazil is having its Argentina moment. How to play it
item.description: Todd Gordon's way to play it is Petrobras (PBR), Brazil's state-controlled integrated oil major.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield backs off from 24-year high after solid bond auction eases demand fears
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields came off their highs after a solid sale of 10-year notes.

item.title: Here comes third-quarter earnings season. Booming profits could propel the S&P 500 to new heights
item.description: Third-quarter earnings season kicks off this week and as results roll in they should reveal what the market is eagerly anticipating: blockbuster profits.

item.title: Strange market anomaly is creating a buying opportunity in the Nasdaq 100
item.description: So instead of buying QQQ outright and exposing your portfolio to severe downside risk, buying calls at current option prices is a smarter, capital-efficient way to stay long.

item.title: ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies
item.description: Research links ICE enforcement surges to lasting declines in local spending, foot traffic and jobs. In Minneapolis, businesses are still recovering.

item.title: The SALT deduction limit is $40,400 for 2026. Here's how to maximize it
item.description: The SALT deduction limit is $40,400 for 2026. Experts cover how to maximize the tax break before year-end.

item.title: Americans grow more pessimistic about their finances, New York Fed finds — expert warns of ‘tough choices’ ahead
item.description: As affordability pressures mount, Americans are increasingly concerned about their financial future, the New York Fed's data shows.

item.title: Trump’s diesel order exposes White House limits to counter surging fuel prices
item.description: President Trump's order comes amid mounting political pressure to take action on surging diesel prices, with the midterm elections only a month away.

item.title: Trading platform Webull's China ties create national security risk, congressional panel finds; stock drops 18%
item.description: A congressional committee says trading platform Webull is not the ordinary U.S. company it claims, but exposes customer data to Chinese surveillance risk.

item.title: Apollo, banks in talks to finance SpaceX's $40 billion Nvidia GPU purchase
item.description: Since SpaceX's record-breaking IPO in June, rates have sold off, and yields on its bonds have risen, along with other AI-related bonds.

item.title: Consumer stocks have been hammered. Here are some opportunities among the casualties
item.description: Brand name consumer stocks have been in a slump. Wall Street sees opportunity to pick some up at bargain prices.

item.title: Disney+ to stream upcoming Super Bowl
item.description: Disney+ will also air two Monday Night Football games leading up to the championship game.

item.title: Jaguar unveils $130,000 electric vehicle two years after controversial rebrand
item.description: The launch comes as luxury rivals Ferrari and Bentley also push into EVs, seeking to test wealthy buyer's appetite for going electric.

item.title: Modelo owner Constellation is getting creative to bring back beer drinkers as overall demand weakens
item.description: Constellation Brands beat earnings and revenue expectations as beer brands gained share, while inventory rebuilding and consumer caution clouded demand.

item.title: Used car prices fall in Q3, while demand for fuel-efficient vehicles grows
item.description: Used vehicle prices are forecast to fall more than previously expected this year, according to Cox Automotive.

item.title: New data strengthens our faith in a TJX comeback. Plus, the Nvidia-Microsoft PC is here
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Airfare is 23% higher than last year. Is now a good time to use points for flights?
item.description: Certain types of award flights don't increase in cost along with the cash price, but that's not always the case.

item.title: Oil prices fall as IEA members agree to prioritize release of diesel stocks
item.description: Iran's move to step up attacks on tankers which are transiting through the Strait of Hormuz has also led to renewed worries over oil supplies among traders.

item.title: Stocks made a record high. Two big bearish trades point to skepticism
item.description: In the State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), about an hour after the opening bell on Tuesday, someone traded a 100,000-lot put spread.

item.title: Rubio says Tehran missed 'multiple' chances for nuclear deal amid Iran stalemate
item.description: Iran has failed to take advantage of "multiple opportunities" to reach a deal on its nuclear program, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Wednesday.

item.title: France is caught between angry students and unforgiving bond markets
item.description: France's student protests took a breather on Wednesday after weeks of unrest, but market pressure on the French government intensified ahead of budget talks.

item.title: Google ordered to halt work on two data centers in ‘Texas of Europe’
item.description: Finland has emerged as a key location for data centers amid the AI boom.

item.title: Porsche braces for lower sales era, seeks lifeline from luxury
item.description: Porsche is bracing for sharply lower sales as it tries to turn its fortunes around with restructuring and a focus on higher-end cars, parent Volkswagen says.

item.title: Meta's Muse assistant tops app charts. Now it needs to become a habit
item.description: Meta’s Muse is free for now as the company searches for a business surrounding its personal AI agent.

item.title: Tropical Storm Isaias forecast to hit U.S. Gulf coast as hurricane early Saturday
item.description: The NHC expects Isaias to develop into a hurricane by Thursday as it quickly picks up power ⁠over the warm Gulf waters before making landfall early Saturday.
